name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit (a hard goal). The current clauses only include a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit), which enforces the order but does not make reaching the exit a required goal. Add a hard Existence(at_exit) clause (or an equivalent hard goal) so that reaching the exit is mandatory; the existing Precedence clause then correctly ensures the switch is toggled before the exit.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause 'Reach the exit.' (hard Existence(at_exit)) adds a hard goal that the original task does not require. The task only states that reaching the exit is allowed only after the switch has been flipped, which is correctly captured by a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit). Remove the hard Existence(at_exit) clause (or make it soft if a goal is intended) and adjust the reward machine (no FINAL_STATES for a rule‑only task).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) clause correctly captures the task “If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.” It enforces that the switch is toggled before the exit, with no unconditional goal needed, matching the rule‑only nature of the task.

texts: The switch must be toggled before reaching the exit.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
